title: Bridge
description: A typed cross-domain edge. The graph models relationships across domains, not only prerequisite chains -- a bridge is what makes the curriculum a graph instead of a syllabus.

from.description: conceptId or domainId this edge originates from.

to.description: conceptId or domainId this edge points to.

description.description: Why this edge is real, not just structurally plausible -- required for CAUSES_CANDIDATE and MATHEMATICALLY_EQUIVALENT_TO, where a wrong edge is a wrong scientific claim, not just a broken link.
